overall_reason: The page's own components (navigation, buttons, section text) hold a small set of values on 4px spacing with 4 and 6px radii; most of the scatter belongs to the product graphics drawn in HTML, and the stylesheet itself could not be read.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY and T-SCALE-FIT pass on the chrome; T-DRIFT-PAIRS finds near-identical blue-grey surfaces and a 5px card radius beside 4 and 6px (TOK-010, TOK-004).

findings.evidence: Light blue-grey surfaces pair #e5edf5 (18 elements) with #e3ecf7, #ecf0f4 and #ebeef1, and white with #f8fafd and #fffafd (values.1440.colour_fill near_duplicates); borders pair #e5edf5 (71) with #e7ecf1 and #152460 with #182659.
findings.after: One tinted-surface value and one hairline value
findings.why: The tints are invisible apart and add values the next section can pick from.

findings.evidence: Shadows use 10 recipes, several with fractional offsets (0px 14.088px 21.132px, 0px 20.187px 40.374px, 0px 15.931px 31.8px), and the bento card content uses a 5px radius beside the 4px buttons and 6px navigation (values.1440.radius, values.1440.shadow).
findings.after: Two elevation recipes and the 4 and 6px radii
findings.why: Fractional shadow offsets are scaled copies, so elevation reads slightly different on each card.

findings.evidence: z-index climbs 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and then jumps to 9999 for one element (values.1440.ladder.over_1000).
findings.after: A named top layer on the same ladder
findings.why: A 9999 layer leaves no room for the next overlay except another nine.

strengths: Spacing sits on a 4px scale (share 0.914 against chance 0.3).
Buttons and navigation share a small radius family (4px on 95 elements, 6px on 78).
Two families (Sohne and Source Code Pro) set all text.
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
T-HARDCODE, T-TOKEN-TIERS, T-THEME-PARITY, T-FRAMEWORK-FIT: 9 of the stylesheets were cross-origin and unreadable (one declaration read), so tokens, naming and themes are unknown, not absent
the product graphics (payments, billing and checkout illustrations built in HTML) carry 8 to 12px text and are exhibits; their sizes were not held to the page's scale
